```plato

    //==
    // # GradientTexture
    //
    // The ramp position is the UV coordinate projected onto the gradient's
    // direction, measured from the corner the direction points away from so that
    // the whole unit square maps into [0, 1]. At Angle zero that is plain U.

    // The gradient parameter at a UV coordinate: the projection onto the
    // direction, normalized by the projected extent of the unit square.
    GradientParameter(self: GradientTexture, uv: UvCoordinate): Number {
        var dx = self.Angle.Cos;
        var dy = self.Angle.Sin;
        // The square's projected span is |dx| + |dy|; the offset places the
        // corner that projects lowest at parameter zero.
        var span = dx.Abs + dy.Abs;
        var offset = (dx < 0.0 ? -dx : 0.0) + (dy < 0.0 ? -dy : 0.0);
        return span == 0.0 ? 0.0 : (uv.U * dx + uv.V * dy + offset) / span;
    }
```
